def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    high_prices = [150, 152, 153]
    low_prices = [145, 148, 149]
    closing_prices = [148, 150, 151]
    volumes = [2000, 3500, 5000]

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    typical_prices = [
        (high + low + close) / 3
        for high, low, close in zip(high_prices, low_prices, closing_prices)
    ]

    total_value = sum(
        typical_price * volume
        for typical_price, volume in zip(typical_prices, volumes)
    )
    total_volume = sum(volumes)
    vwap = total_value / total_volume
    answer = round(vwap, 2)

    # return answer
    return answer
